root_cause.text: The `l2cap_information_rsp()` function in the L2CAP subsystem failed to validate that the total command length (`cmd_len`) included the type-specific payload (e.g., 4 bytes for FEAT_MASK, 1 byte for FIXED_CHAN) before reading `rsp->data`, allowing an out-of-bounds read when a truncated L2CAP_INFO_RSP with result SUCCESS is received.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description and commit message state: "l2cap_information_rsp() checks that cmd_len covers the fixed l2cap_info_rsp header (type + result, 4 bytes) but then reads rsp->data without verifying that the payload is present: L2CAP_IT_FEAT_MASK calls get_unaligned_le32(rsp->data), which reads 4 bytes past the header (needs cmd_len >= 8). L2CAP_IT_FIXED_CHAN reads rsp->data[0], 1 byte past the header (needs cmd_len >= 5)." The patch adds explicit length checks (`cmd_len >= sizeof(*rsp) + sizeof(u32)` and `cmd_len >= sizeof(*rsp) + sizeof(rsp->data[0])`) before each payload access.
